svg.title: Batch norm at training and test time
svg.desc: Training takes mean and variance from the current mini-batch and also updates running averages; test uses the stored averages; both use the same learned gamma and beta.
svg.text: batch mean and variance (divide by m)
scale and shift: o = γ x̄ + β
Test: statistics from storage, no batch
scale and shift: o = γ x̄ + β
Training uses batch statistics, so each output
depends on the other samples in the batch. At test
time one input has no usable batch variance, so the
stored averages are used and the output for x = 6 is
always 0.837, whatever else is being predicted.
